title: 美银Winnie：中国K型分化加剧，散户难赚钱
speaker: Winnie

segments.en: I would say that partly because the wealthy fact of the stock market is far less prevailing in China. I mean, you know, Korea, Taiwan, much smaller population, right?
segments.zh: 部分原因是股市的财富效应在中国远没有那么普遍。韩国、台湾人口少得多。

segments.en: So you know, like I think Samsung has like five million of retail shareholders, lots of millionaires now. Exactly, right? So the wealthy fact is much more evident driving the luxury car sales, you know, the spending in Korea.
segments.zh: 三星有500万散户股东，催生了很多百万富翁，财富效应明显，推动韩国奢侈品消费。

segments.en: Whereas in China, the wealthy fact in the stock market might only benefiting a very small part of the population, right? The people in Lu Jiazui, and also in Korea, the two stock has done very well over the past 12 months.
segments.zh: 而在中国，股市财富效应只惠及极少数人，比如陆家嘴的从业者。韩国两只股票过去12个月表现很好。

segments.en: Whereas in China, even as professionals, we need to constantly look at rotations, changing scenes, right? You know, the stock you bought a year ago, new consumption, right? It's not necessarily making you money today.
segments.zh: 在中国，即使是专业人士也需要不断关注轮动和变化。一年前买的新消费股，今天不一定赚钱。

segments.en: So for retailers, can they really make money in this kind of rapid rotation? That's another challenge.
segments.zh: 对于散户来说，在这种快速轮动中真的能赚钱吗？这是另一个挑战。
